fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Passports must be valid for 6 months from the date of arrival.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una validez de 6 meses desde la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: Passports must be valid for 6 months from date of arrival.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter the UAE, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: It is illegal to bring pork products or pornography into the UAE.
entry.es: Es ilegal traer productos de cerdo o pornografía a los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.
entry.quote: It is illegal to bring pork products or pornography into the UAE.

entry.en: You must get approval in advance from the UAE Ministry of Health to bring medication.
entry.es: Debes obtener aprobación previa del Ministerio de Salud de los EAU para traer medicamentos.
entry.quote: You must get approval in advance from the UAE Ministry of Health to bring medication.

entry.en: Visitors can bring up to 3 months' supply of medication, reduced to one month's supply if it is on the list requiring approval.
entry.es: Los visitantes pueden traer hasta 3 meses de medicación, reducidos a un mes si está en la lista que requiere aprobación.
entry.quote: You can bring up to 3 months’ supply of medication as a visitor, reduced to one month’s supply if the medication is included in the list requiring approval.

entry.en: Each non-Muslim adult can bring in four items of alcohol, regardless of alcohol content.
entry.es: Cada adulto no musulmán puede introducir cuatro unidades de alcohol, sin importar su graduación.
entry.quote: Each non-Muslim adult can bring in four items of alcohol, e.g. four bottles of wine, or four bottles of spirits, or four cases of beer (regardless of alcohol content).

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in the UAE.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

safety.en: Possessing even the smallest amount of illegal drugs, including cannabis, can mean at least 3 months in prison or a fine of 20,000 to 100,000 dirham.
safety.es: Poseer incluso la menor cantidad de drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, puede suponer al menos 3 meses de cárcel o una multa de 20.000 a 100.000 dírhams.
safety.quote: Possession of even the smallest amount of illegal drugs, including cannabis, can lead to a minimum 3-month prison term or a fine of between 20,000 UAE dirham and 100,000 UAE dirham.

safety.en: It is illegal to drink or be under the influence of alcohol in a public place anywhere in the UAE.
safety.es: Es ilegal beber o estar bajo los efectos del alcohol en un lugar público en cualquier parte de los EAU.
safety.quote: It is illegal to drink or be under the influence of alcohol in a public place anywhere in the UAE.

safety.en: Only cross roads at designated pedestrian crossings, as crossing elsewhere is illegal and may bring a fine or even imprisonment.
safety.es: Cruza solo por los pasos peatonales designados; hacerlo en otro sitio es ilegal y puede acarrear multa o incluso cárcel.
safety.quote: Only cross roads using designated pedestrian crossings. It is illegal to cross in other places and you may face a fine or even imprisonment.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in the UAE, and same-sex marriages are not recognised.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en los EAU y no se reconocen los matrimonios homosexuales.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in the UAE, and same-sex marriages are not recognised.

safety.en: Swearing and making rude gestures, including online, are illegal as obscene acts.
safety.es: Decir palabrotas y hacer gestos groseros, también en línea, es ilegal por considerarse actos obscenos.
safety.quote: It is illegal to swear and make rude gestures, including online, as they are considered obscene acts.

health.en: Healthcare is similar to the UK, but you may be stopped from using it without travel insurance or means to pay.
health.es: La atención médica es similar a la del Reino Unido, pero pueden impedirte usarla sin seguro de viaje o sin medios para pagar.
health.quote: Healthcare facilities in the UAE are similar to those in the UK, but you may be stopped from using them without travel insurance or without the means to pay medical fees.

health.en: You may be prevented from leaving the UAE if you cannot pay your medical bill.
health.es: Pueden impedirte salir de los EAU si no puedes pagar tu factura médica.
health.quote: You may be prevented from leaving the UAE if you are unable to pay your medical bill.

health.en: Some UK-prescribed and over-the-counter medicines are considered controlled substances in the UAE.
health.es: Algunos medicamentos con receta o de venta libre del Reino Unido se consideran sustancias controladas en los EAU.
health.quote: In the UAE, some UK prescribed and over-the-counter medicines are considered controlled substances.

health.en: The water is safe to drink in the UAE, although most people prefer bottled water for its taste.
health.es: El agua es potable en los EAU, aunque la mayoría prefiere agua embotellada por su sabor.
health.quote: The water is safe to drink in the UAE, although most people prefer bottled water for its taste.

health.en: The country is free of malaria and prophylaxis is not needed.
health.es: El país está libre de malaria y no se necesita profilaxis.
health.quote: The country is free of malaria and prophylaxis is not needed.

health.en: Summer heat can reach 50°C, so avoid outdoor activity at the height of the day and watch for heat stroke.
health.es: El calor del verano puede llegar a 50 °C, así que evita la actividad al aire libre en las horas centrales y vigila los signos de golpe de calor.
health.quote: The heat in summer can reach 50°C (122°F), so avoid outdoor activity at the height of the day and watch out for signs of heat stroke.

help.en: For an ambulance in the UAE, dial 998.
help.es: Para una ambulancia en los EAU, marca el 998.
help.quote: Dial 998 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: Emergency numbers in the UAE are 998 for ambulance, 997 for fire and 999 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en los EAU son 998 (ambulancia), 997 (bomberos) y 999 (policía).

getting_in.en: Dubai International Airport (DXB) is served by several major airlines, most notably Emirates.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Dubái (DXB) cuenta con varias grandes aerolíneas, sobre todo Emirates.
getting_in.quote: Dubai International Airport (DXB IATA) – This airport is served by several major airlines, most notably Dubai's flag carrier Emirates.

getting_in.en: Zayed International Airport (AUH) near Abu Dhabi has the next best international connections after Dubai.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Zayed (AUH), cerca de Abu Dabi, tiene las mejores conexiones internacionales después de Dubái.
getting_in.quote: Zayed International Airport (AUH IATA) near Abu Dhabi – This airport has the next best international connections after Dubai.

getting_in.en: Sharjah International Airport (SHJ) is the home of low-cost carrier Air Arabia.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Sharjah (SHJ) es la base de la aerolínea de bajo costo Air Arabia.
getting_in.quote: Sharjah International Airport (SHJ IATA) – It is the home of the low-cost carrier Air Arabia, which has connections with various Middle East and Indian Subcontinent cities.

getting_in.en: There is road access to the UAE from Saudi Arabia in the south and Oman in the east.
getting_in.es: Hay acceso por carretera a los EAU desde Arabia Saudita al sur y Omán al este.
getting_in.quote: There is road access to the United Arab Emirates from Saudi Arabia in the south and Oman in the east.

getting_in.en: Private operators and Oman's state-owned Mwasalat run regular buses from Oman to the UAE.
getting_in.es: Operadores privados y la estatal omaní Mwasalat ofrecen autobuses regulares de Omán a los EAU.
getting_in.quote: From Oman to the UAE private operators as well as the Omani state owned Mwasalat operate regular buses.

getting_in.en: As of November 2022, foreigners can drive through the Mazyad / Batha al Ashkar border crossing from Oman.
getting_in.es: Desde noviembre de 2022, los extranjeros pueden cruzar en coche por el paso fronterizo de Mazyad / Batha al Ashkar desde Omán.
getting_in.quote: As of November of 2022, you can drive through the Mazyad / Batha al Ashkar border crossing from Oman as a foreigner.

getting_around.en: You can travel between any two emirates in under two hours, and there are no domestic flights.
getting_around.es: Se puede viajar entre cualquier par de emiratos en menos de dos horas y no hay vuelos internos.
getting_around.quote: The country has an excellent network of highways and you can travel from any emirate to another in under two hours, with Dubai and Abu Dhabi about 140 km (90 min) apart. There are no domestic flights.

getting_around.en: Etihad Rail's single line links Fujairah and Mohamed bin Zayed City, with three trains daily each way and tickets from Dh109.
getting_around.es: La única línea de Etihad Rail une Fujairah y la ciudad Mohamed bin Zayed, con tres trenes diarios por sentido y billetes desde Dh109.
getting_around.quote: As of June 2026, this consists of a single line between Fujairah and Mohamed bin Zayed (MBZ) City on the outskirts of Abu Dhabi, with three trains daily each way taking 1:45 and tickets starting from Dh109 one way.

getting_around.en: Dubai has an extensive metro, plus a monorail on Palm Jumeirah and a tram in Dubai Marina.
getting_around.es: Dubái tiene un extenso metro, además de un monorraíl en Palm Jumeirah y un tranvía en Dubai Marina.
getting_around.quote: There is an extensive metro system in Dubai that connects various parts of the city, as well as a monorail in Palm Jumeriah and a tram in Dubai Marina area.

getting_around.en: Taxis are widely available and relatively affordable, and Uber and Careem are common.
getting_around.es: Los taxis abundan y son relativamente asequibles, y Uber y Careem son habituales.
getting_around.quote: In all cities of the UAE, taxis are widely available and relatively affordable. Local ride share apps such as Uber and Careem are also common in the UAE.

getting_around.en: Renting a car or driving requires an international driver's license, which is a translation of your standard license.
getting_around.es: Alquilar o conducir un coche requiere un permiso de conducir internacional, que es una traducción de tu permiso habitual.
getting_around.quote: Renting a car or driving in the UAE requires an international driver's license, which is simply a translation of your standard license and can be acquired at a local automobile association.

getting_around.en: Crossing the Salik toll gate in Dubai costs 4 dirham and requires a prepaid Salik Tag.
getting_around.es: Cruzar el peaje Salik en Dubái cuesta 4 dírhams y requiere una etiqueta Salik prepagada.
getting_around.quote: A toll of 4 dirham is charged to cross the Salik toll gate in Dubai. A prepaid Salik Tag is required for this.

money.en: The currency is the United Arab Emirates dirham.
money.es: La moneda es el dírham de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.
money.quote: The currency is the United Arab Emirates dirham

money.en: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito se aceptan ampliamente.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted.

money.en: ATM withdrawals are free at some banks such as Emirates NBD and HSBC, while others charge about 20 dirhams.
money.es: Retirar en cajeros es gratis en algunos bancos como Emirates NBD y HSBC, mientras que otros cobran unos 20 dírhams.
money.quote: Withdrawing money is for free for example at Emirates NBD, Emirates Islamic Bank, HSBC and ADIB. While it costs about 20 dirhams at the ATMs of ADCB, Mashreq, DIB and Ajman Bank.

money.en: It is better to be debited in local currency than to accept dynamic currency conversion; tell the cashier "in dirham".
money.es: Es mejor que te cobren en moneda local que aceptar la conversión dinámica; di al cajero "in dirham".
money.quote: It is always better to be debited in the local currency instead of accepting this conversion into your home country's currency; just say to the cashier "in dirham".

money.en: Most purchases in the UAE are subject to a 5% value-added tax.
money.es: La mayoría de las compras en los EAU llevan un impuesto sobre el valor añadido del 5 %.
money.quote: Most purchases in the UAE are subject to a 5% value-added tax (VAT).

money.en: Tourists may request a VAT exemption on purchases over 250 dirhams in a single transaction if they leave within 90 days with the goods.
money.es: Los turistas pueden solicitar la exención del IVA en compras de más de 250 dírhams en una sola transacción si salen en 90 días con los productos.
money.quote: Foreign tourists may request a VAT exemption when making purchases at a participating shop provided the cost exceeds 250 dirhams in a single transaction, and you depart the UAE with the goods within 90 days of making the purchase.

etiquette.en: Hijab and modest clothing are necessary to visit mosques or religious sites.
etiquette.es: Se necesitan hiyab y ropa recatada para visitar mezquitas o sitios religiosos.
etiquette.quote: Hijab and modest clothing are necessary to visit mosques or religious sites.

etiquette.en: Women are not legally required to wear the hijab, but revealing fashions such as tank tops and shorts are discouraged.
etiquette.es: Las mujeres no están obligadas legalmente a llevar hiyab, pero se desaconseja la ropa reveladora como camisetas sin mangas y shorts.
etiquette.quote: Although women are not legally required to wear the hijab, revealing fashions such as tank tops and shorts are discouraged.

etiquette.en: Public nudity anywhere is strictly forbidden.
etiquette.es: La desnudez pública está estrictamente prohibida en cualquier lugar.
etiquette.quote: Public nudity anywhere is strictly forbidden.

etiquette.en: Public display of affection towards a spouse is considered impolite by the Emirati population.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto hacia el cónyuge se consideran descorteses para la población emiratí.
etiquette.quote: Public display of affection towards a spouse is considered impolite or ill-mannered to the Emirati population.

etiquette.en: Business cards should be given and received using only your right hand.
etiquette.es: Las tarjetas de visita deben darse y recibirse solo con la mano derecha.
etiquette.quote: Business cards should be given and received using only your right hand.

etiquette.en: Do not speak badly of someone's family member.
etiquette.es: No hables mal de ningún familiar de otra persona.
etiquette.quote: Do not speak badly of someone's family member.

connectivity.en: Two providers have their own cellular networks: e& (etisalat) and du.
connectivity.es: Dos operadores tienen red móvil propia: e& (etisalat) y du.
connectivity.quote: There are two providers who have their own cellular network: e& (etisalat) and du.

connectivity.en: As of January 2026, tourists passing passport control are given a free SIM card valid for one day.
connectivity.es: Desde enero de 2026, los turistas que pasan el control de pasaportes reciben una SIM gratuita válida por un día.
connectivity.quote: As of January 2026, tourists passing through passport control are given a free SIM card valid for one day, and tied to their passport identity.

connectivity.en: 4 GB for 28 days costs 49 dirham (Jan 2026) at both providers.
connectivity.es: 4 GB durante 28 días cuestan 49 dírhams (ene. 2026) en ambos operadores.
connectivity.quote: 4 GB for 28 days costs 49 dirham (Jan 2026) at both providers with the SIM card for free.

connectivity.en: Voice and video calls on many popular apps like WhatsApp and Snapchat are blocked, while Zoom and Microsoft Teams work fine.
connectivity.es: Las llamadas de voz y video en muchas apps populares como WhatsApp y Snapchat están bloqueadas, mientras que Zoom y Microsoft Teams funcionan bien.
connectivity.quote: Making voice or video calls on many popular apps like WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Snapchat are blocked, although messaging and "corporate" video call tools like Zoom and Microsoft Teams work fine.

connectivity.en: VPN usage is formally illegal, even though most people use one to bypass restrictions.
connectivity.es: El uso de VPN es formalmente ilegal, aunque la mayoría lo usa para eludir las restricciones.
connectivity.quote: Most people use a VPN service to bypass local Internet restrictions, but VPN usage is formally illegal, especially if used to conceal committing a crime.
